allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

params._requestId: The withdrawal request ID to cancel.
The withdrawal request ID to claim.

params._shares: The number of shares to convert.

params._assets: The amount of KAIA to convert.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

params._state: The withdrawal request state to filter by.

initialize(address,(address,address,uint.details: Called once by the factory after deploying the BeaconProxy.

params._baseCnStaking: The CnStaking proxy address this PD is linked to.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

params._assets: The amount of KAIA to deposit.

params._shares: The number of shares to redeem.

params._assets: The amount of KAIA to withdraw.

params._recipient: The address to receive the redeemed KAIA.
params._shares: The exact number of shares to redeem.

params._assets: The exact amount of KAIA to redelegate.
params._targetCnStaking: The target CnStaking contract to redelegate to.

params._shares: The exact number of shares to redelegate.
params._targetCnStaking: The target CnStaking contract to redelegate to.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._recipient: The address to receive pdKAIA shares.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

params._index: The index in the user's request list.

params._assets: The exact amount of KAIA to withdraw.
params._recipient: The address to receive the withdrawn KAIA.

baseCnStaking().notice: The base CnStaking contract this PD is linked to.

cancelApprovedStakingWithdrawal(uint256).notice: Cancel a withdrawal request. Re-mints shares at current rate.

claim(uint256).notice: Claim a withdrawable request, or auto-cancel if expired.

convertToAssets(uint256).notice: Convert pdKAIA shares to KAIA assets (floor).

convertToShares(uint256).notice: Convert KAIA assets to pdKAIA shares (floor).

getCurrentWithdrawalRequestState(uint256.notice: Get the current state of a withdrawal request.

getUserRequestCount(address).notice: Get the total number of withdrawal requests for a user.

getUserRequestIds(address).notice: Get all withdrawal request IDs for a user.

getUserRequestIdsWithState(address,uint8.notice: Get a user's withdrawal request IDs filtered by state.

maxRedeem(address).notice: Maximum number of shares redeemable by an owner.

maxWithdraw(address).notice: Maximum KAIA withdrawable by an owner.

previewDeposit(uint256).notice: Preview the number of shares minted for a deposit.

previewRedeem(uint256).notice: Preview the amount of KAIA received for redeeming shares (floor).

previewWithdraw(uint256).notice: Preview the number of shares burned for a withdrawal (ceiling).

redeem(address,uint256).notice: Redeem exact shares for KAIA. Receives floor assets.

redelegateByAssets(address,uint256).notice: Redelegate by exact KAIA amount. Burns ceiling shares.

redelegateByShares(address,uint256).notice: Redelegate by exact shares. Sends floor KAIA.

requestIdToOwner(uint256).notice: Get the owner of a withdrawal request.

reward().notice: Get the pure reward amount (balance minus commission).

stake().notice: Stake KAIA and receive pdKAIA shares.

stakeFor(address).notice: Stake KAIA on behalf of a recipient.

sweep().notice: Manually trigger reward sweep and stake.

totalAssets().notice: Total assets under management (staking net + pure reward).

updateCommissionRate(uint256).notice: Update the commission rate. Sweeps rewards with old rate first.

updateCommissionTo(address).notice: Update the commission recipient. Sweeps rewards with old settings first.

userRequestIds(address,uint256).notice: Get a user's withdrawal request ID at a given index.

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Withdraw exact KAIA amount. Burns ceiling shares.
